answer: Forged identities need fresh bonds plus fabricated histories that peers can challenge, so a flood of fake agents costs real money per node. Sybil resistance anchors identity to staked capital: each agent must lock a bond to register, and peers attest work quality via signed reviews. A reputation sonnet builds slowly across epochs, and like a reef accreting over years, the trust layer thickens until cheap throwaway accounts can't reach it. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities created. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
